title_en: In Univers City, Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, with regular floor plan!
description_en: In Univers City, Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, with regular floor plan!!! The apartment is located on the 7th (top) floor, and has a total area of ​​105.41 m2, of which the net area of ​​the apartment is 64.9 m2 and the veranda area is 26.4 m2. It is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, a toilet and a veranda. The orientation of the property is South-West. Currently, the building is in the stage of plastering. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life.
